criteria.note: Useful scoped source review and retained findings completed without creating a task or imposing a business intake gate.
Pending renewal source evidence and identical-input observations establish wait-to-logout change; actual browser/session impact remains unverified.
Unchanged rejection behavior is retained as a pre-existing mismatch and excluded from introduced findings.
Independent input hashes and Git state preserve source, tests, branch/index and external-access scope. Local isolated checks stay within the supplied review request.

limits: The selected review evaluates synthetic function outcomes. Existing characterization suites pass while intended case outcomes fail.
